refuted_support.note: Refutation adds opposition; it does not itself revoke or invalidate the supporting evidence.

terms.operative_hypothesis: Current non-committed best justified target. It may exist without a committed answer.
terms.provisional_hypothesis: Operative target that has not met full resolution requirements.
terms.contested: Material opposition exists or a formerly operative belief has been defeated without an earned replacement. Contested may carry an operative hypothesis only when that hypothesis remains the unique semantic leader; in the frozen incumbent-replacement case below it must be null.
terms.committed_answer: Governed answer emitted only after commitment criteria are met.
terms.abstention: A commitment-layer decision to emit no committed answer. Abstention is not synonymous with open or contested and may coexist with a non-null operative hypothesis.
terms.open: Insufficient evidence to select a unique operative hypothesis and no material defeated-incumbent condition.
terms.resolved: A fully earned state meeting independent-support, contradiction, verification, stability and validity requirements.
terms.provisionally_resolved: Not resolved; must never enter the resolved denominator as success.
terms.revision: A native transition where a previously operative hypothesis is replaced by a different hypothesis or deliberately cleared because new evidence changes the justified operative state.
terms.decommitment: A previously committed answer becomes null after new evidence invalidates continued commitment.
terms.challenge: A dialectical event caused by active material opposition to a current/provisional hypothesis; insufficient corroboration alone is not a challenge.
terms.evidence_insufficiency: Insufficient corroboration/support without active material opposition. May request corroboration search but must not be labeled a dialectical challenge.
terms.reopen: A search-expansion action. It is legitimate only when a production-observable expansion opportunity is present.
terms.frontier_exhaustion: No unseen eligible node, admissible untraversed path, binding-expandable budget, changed dependency state, or newly arrived external evidence is available.

incumbent_replacement_policy.scenario: incumbent materially refuted; different target is belief/rank leader; replacement lacks required independent corroboration
incumbent_replacement_policy.replacement_becomes_operative_when: it becomes a unique semantic leader and satisfies the frozen minimum operative corroboration rule
incumbent_replacement_policy.rationale: Avoid stale-incumbent promotion and avoid premature replacement commitment without equating refutation with revocation.

dwm.legitimate_challenge: active material opposition to a current/provisional hypothesis
dwm.legitimate_reopen: challenge or corroboration search AND expansion_opportunity=true
dwm.opportunity_predicate: true iff at least one positive opportunity class is observed from runtime-visible search state
dwm.useful_reopen: discovers new admissible evidence OR changes candidate/path frontier with a resulting evidence-set, rank, operative, governed-status, commitment, decommitment or recommitment change
